prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 90.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 70.9%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Habitat Customization Pre-Flight Screen: Add a new setup screen where users pick a desktop room backdrop before generating their official adoption certificate. (why: Adoption has a 71.1% conversion rate and high completion time (1017s mean); introducing early customization increases user attachment.)
1: [home, new_flow] Desktop Interactive Playground Waiting Flow: Transform the waiting screen into an interactive desktop mini-playground flow with clickable toys and companion animations during download. (why: The waiting step takes median 201s and mean 2336s, leading to abandonment while asset generation occurs.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Waiting Sign-In Order Shift: Move sign-in step after waiting stage so users create their account after seeing their rendered companion ready to land on desktop. (why: Sign-in drops 22.6% of users early; moving account creation right before finish leverages motivation when the pet is already built.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Clear Onboarding Duration Commitment Headline: Update story screen headline and body copy to set explicit expectations about quick 2-minute setup. (why: High mean times in early steps suggest users hesitate without a clear commitment baseline.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Lighting Correction Live Helper Hint: Add an explicit photo lighting guidance banner on upload_photos screen to assist custom pet generation accuracy. (why: Support mailbox received 3 emails reporting failed custom pets or incorrect generation output.)
5: [home, wait_info] Asset Download Sub-Stage Progress Tracker: Show dynamic sub-stage progress indicators and real-time step counters on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step has a very long mean time (2336s); sub-stage information keeps users informed during heavy asset downloads.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Visibility Health Diagnostic Indicator: Include a desktop rendering health check sound and visual verification component on the home_intro screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to open upon finishing setup.)

scores.note: Adding extra screens to a long step increases friction and drop-off risks.
Interactive waiting flow reduces drop-off during long 2336s mean download times.
Delaying sign-in until value is demonstrated removes major upfront drop-off.
Copy change setting time expectations reduces initial step hesitation at low cost.
Directly targets 3 support emails and 28.9% adoption drop-off with simple guidance.
Sub-stage progress tracker reassures users during heavy background downloads.
Solves reported desktop rendering bugs impacting the 29.1% finish step loss.
